legal.title: Legal
legal.subtitle: Terms, privacy, and license details for this app.
legal.consentSubtitle: Please review and accept the terms below to use this app. You can re-read them anytime under Legal on the Me tab.
legal.consentDisclaimer: By tapping 'I agree and continue' you confirm that you have read and accept the Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, and End User License Agreement.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of the app. Please read them before continuing.
terms.s1Body: You may use the app for lawful, personal purposes. Do not misuse it, try to disrupt it, or use it to harm others.
terms.s2Body: The app does not sell anything. The paywall is a preview of the screen, and no payment is taken. If paid features are added later, the App Store or Google Play bills them under its own terms and handles refunds.
terms.s3Body: Nothing you enter is uploaded. Your preferences stay on this device, as described in the Privacy Policy.
terms.s4Body: We may update these terms when the app changes. When we do, the app asks you to accept the new version before you continue.
terms.s5Body: The app is provided as-is. To the maximum extent permitted by law, we disclaim all warranties and limit our liability for any indirect or consequential damages.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what data the app handles and where it is kept.
privacy.s1Body: Nothing. The app has no accounts, analytics, or crash reporting, and it does not send your data to any server. The sign-in and sign-up forms only check what you type; they do not submit it anywhere.
privacy.s2Body: Your theme, language, and app lock setting, whether you finished onboarding, the version of these terms you accepted, and when the app last asked you for a rating. They are saved on this device only.
privacy.s3Body: Camera, photos, and tracking are requested only when you tap them on the Permissions screen. Face ID or fingerprint is checked by the system, and the app never sees your biometric data. The app does not track you.
privacy.s4Body: Deleting the app removes everything it saved. You can change permissions at any time in your device settings.
privacy.s5Body: Questions about privacy can be sent to the support email listed on the app's store page.

eula.title: End User License Agreement
eula.intro: This license sets the conditions under which you may install and use the app.
eula.s1Body: We grant you a non-transferable, non-exclusive license to use the app on devices you own or control, subject to the platform's usage rules.
eula.s2Body: You may not reverse engineer, redistribute, or sublicense the app, except to the extent permitted by applicable law.
eula.s3Body: Updates may be delivered automatically. New versions can change features, security boundaries, or platform requirements.
eula.s4Body: This license terminates automatically if you breach its terms. On termination you must stop using the app and delete it from your devices.
